''See also: [[Northstrider Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Northstrider, also known as Master Northstrider, is a legendary [[Monarch]] who walks the [[Path of the Hungry Deep]]. A powerful and imposing figure, he is described as a tall, muscular man with golden, slit-like eyes, wild hair, and black [[scales]] covering his hands up to his elbows. He is known as a dragon-eating [[Monarch]] who consumes [[sacred beasts]] in the world's deepest locations to acquire their power. As a wandering artist without a formal sect or clan, he serves as a leader for unaffiliated [[sacred artists]] and maintains a presence in the territory between the [[dragons]] and the [[Akura clan]]. He is the creator of [[Ghostwater]], a [[pocket world]] he constructed to research ways to enhance his mental processes and sharpen his mind. His abilities include the use of [[hunger madra]], the capacity to copy the wills of those he devours into his techniques, and the command of fundamental worldly principles through his [[Authority|authority]]. Northstrider has been a significant figure for centuries, acting as a benefactor to [[Lindon]] and an enemy to the [[Gold dragons|gold dragons]]. Despite rumors of his death, he has appeared as an arbiter for major events like the [[Uncrowned King Tournament|Uncrowned King tournament]]. His long-term ambitions involve acquiring enough power and resources, such as [[labyrinth|the labyrinth]] and [[Dross]], to challenge the [[Abidan]].}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Northstrider is a huge, muscular man with glowing golden eyes that feature vertical slits like a gold dragon. His hands are covered in black [[scales]] up to his elbows, though he has also been described as having red-scaled fists.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|A powerful [[Monarch]] and [[Sage]], Northstrider is driven by a curiosity that resonates with [[hunger madra]] and an intent to gather power to force the [[Abidan]] to remove the [[Dreadgods]]. He is a smart and commanding figure who has expressed resentment regarding being summoned.}}

== Relationships ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Northstrider is the master of [[Ziel of the Wasteland|Ziel]], who acts as his representative in the [[Uncrowned King Tournament|Uncrowned tournament]]. He has clashed with [[Reigan Shen]] and is the greatest enemy of the [[dragons]], including the [[Weeping Dragon]] who killed him in battle. He provides protection to [[Eithan]] and has a complex relationship with [[Lindon]], who resents him but also tutored him. Additionally, [[Min Shuei]] has appealed to him and the [[Herald of the green dragons]] holds a centuries-old grudge against him.}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Following the [[Path of the Hungry Deep]], Northstrider utilizes blood, [[hunger]], force, and [[Wind aura|wind aura]] to perform various techniques. He can manifest a [[Remnant]] made of [[blood madra]], use [[Enforcer]] punches, and employ living techniques shaped like [[red dragons]]. His diverse skills include [[spiritual perception]], the ability to restore both minds and bodies, and the use of an [[oracle codex]] for predictions.}}

{{spoiler|book=cradle-05-ghostwater|Northstrider is a [[Monarch]] on the [[Path of the Hungry Deep]] who created [[Ghostwater]].<ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c2">''Ghostwater'', chapter 2</ref><ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c8">''Ghostwater'', chapter 8</ref><ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c19">''Ghostwater'', chapter 19</ref> Nearly fifty years before his death, he abandoned [[Ghostwater]] and withdrew both his presence and protection from the realm.<ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c2" /><ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c7">''Ghostwater'', chapter 7</ref> In an effort to enhance his mind, he built a [[pocket world]] and even attempted to create a collective mind, though this endeavor failed due to a lack of initiative and creativity.<ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c6">''Ghostwater'', chapter 6</ref><ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c15">''Ghostwater'', chapter 15</ref><ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c18">''Ghostwater'', chapter 18</ref> Scholars theorized that a super-spirit of [[Dreamseeds]] might have been created to manage thoughts for him.<ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c13">''Ghostwater'', chapter 13</ref> He maintained personal quarters within the facility and scattered over four thousand memory storage constructs throughout the world.<ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c8" /><ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c16">''Ghostwater'', chapter 16</ref> Northstrider left [[soulfire]] stored at the base of the basin and established that returning the [[Eye of the Deep]] to the tree would grant a single question and one drop of [[Ghostwater|ghostwater]].<ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c16" /><ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c18" /> He possesses [[Eyes of the Deep]] as well as a smooth black orb [[construct]] that serves as an advanced version of those eyes.<ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c19" />}}

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-07-uncrowned|Uncrowned Tournament}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-07-uncrowned|Northstrider is a wandering [[Monarch]] of the [[Trackless Sea]] who was born with a connection to blood and once lost his life in battle against the [[Weeping Dragon]].<ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c10">''Uncrowned'', chapter 10</ref><ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c21">''Uncrowned'', chapter 21</ref> Emerging from a ragged, blue-edged hole in midair, he possesses golden eyes with vertical slits and black [[scales]] that cover his hands up to his elbows.<ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c10" /><ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c11">''Uncrowned'', chapter 11</ref> As one of the youngest [[Archlord|Archlords]] ever and the patron of the [[Uncrowned King Tournament|Uncrowned tournament]], he serves as a [[Monarch]] who decides matchups and commands the start of the competition.<ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c11" /><ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c13">''Uncrowned'', chapter 13</ref><ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c15">''Uncrowned'', chapter 15</ref> He oversees the event from a [[Monarch viewing platform]] located atop a high rectangular pillar on a maze, standing above a dark globe of floating water.<ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c17">''Uncrowned'', chapter 17</ref><ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c19">''Uncrowned'', chapter 19</ref><ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c21" /> During the tournament rounds, his protection is in effect as he uses his power to carry competitors through the air.<ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c15" /><ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c19" /> While surveying sixteen young [[Underlord|Underlords]], he pitted [[Yerin]] and [[Lindon]] against each other, an action that caused [[Lindon]] to feel resentment.<ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c18">''Uncrowned'', chapter 18</ref><ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c20">''Uncrowned'', chapter 20</ref> Ultimately, he announced the [[Akura prime team|Akura team]] as the victor.<ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c16">''Uncrowned'', chapter 16</ref>}}

{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|Northstrider shared insights regarding dragon strategy with the group and presented a scripted ceramic tile as a gift.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c18">''Wintersteel'', chapter 18</ref><ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c19">''Wintersteel'', chapter 19</ref> A [[Monarch]] who stands in the center of the arena, Northstrider resents being summoned.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c21">''Wintersteel'', chapter 21</ref> After restoring [[Yerin]]'s body and spirit, Northstrider provided a restoration that would have otherwise taken weeks to recover Ruby's scraps.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c22">''Wintersteel'', chapter 22</ref> He emphasized the importance of finding common ground between [[Lindon]]'s three [[madra]] types and consumes [[madra]] from the [[Dreadgods]] to help track when they might wake.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c23">''Wintersteel'', chapter 23</ref> [[Lindon]] possesses Northstrider's [[hunger madra]] technique, and the [[Monarch]] is capable of restoring the [[Moonlight Bridge]].<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c24">''Wintersteel'', chapter 24</ref><ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c25">''Wintersteel'', chapter 25</ref> Northstrider makes announcements to initiate fights, leading Ruby to wonder if he might split her and [[Yerin]] apart again.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c26">''Wintersteel'', chapter 26</ref> Utilizing [[blood madra]], Northstrider possesses an experimental [[Presence]] and holds an [[oracle codex]] within his [[soulspace]].<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c27">''Wintersteel'', chapter 27</ref> Having clashed with [[Reigan Shen]] numerous times, Northstrider once unleashed a [[binding]] shield that covered a square mile.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c27" /><ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c28">''Wintersteel'', chapter 28</ref>}}

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-09-bloodline|Champion of Bloodline}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-09-bloodline|Having previously brought back the dead, Northstrider is a champion whose emblem is depicted as a red dragon head with golden eyes.<ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c9">''Bloodline'', chapter 9</ref><ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c14">''Bloodline'', chapter 14</ref> He possesses the ability to utilize both force and [[Blood aura|blood aura]], which allows him to draw streams of blood into vials through mere thought.<ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c17">''Bloodline'', chapter 17</ref> In addition to possessing a [[void key]] and the ability to travel by pushing through [[Way|the Way]], he understands the nature of [[hunger madra]] better than any other living person.<ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c17" /> During combat, he slammed his fist into the [[Dreadgod]]'s head and employed a serpentine dragon made of scarlet [[madra]].<ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c17" /> While moving toward the [[Wandering Titan]] in a vision, he worked to recover his spirit midair while assessing the strength lost during his battle with [[The Phoenix|the Phoenix]].<ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c18">''Bloodline'', chapter 18</ref><ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c21">''Bloodline'', chapter 21</ref>}}

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-10-reaper|Tidewalker Herald}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-10-reaper|As a [[Tidewalker]] [[Herald]], Northstrider possesses the ability to rouse and direct the [[Dreadgods]].<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c2">''Reaper'', chapter 2</ref> While [[Lindon]] hoped for contact regarding [[Dross]], [[Malice]] maintains the ability to call upon him.<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c9">''Reaper'', chapter 9</ref><ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c10">''Reaper'', chapter 10</ref> His subordinates have studied [[dreadbeasts]], and he is capable of copying the wills of those he devours into his own techniques.<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c12">''Reaper'', chapter 12</ref><ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c20">''Reaper'', chapter 20</ref> Northstrider is familiar with how [[labyrinth|the labyrinth]] functions and was observed watching a [[Dreadgod]] from a distance.<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c25">''Reaper'', chapter 25</ref><ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c26">''Reaper'', chapter 26</ref> He also possesses a codex characterized by a reflective black surface.<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c26" />}}

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|Labyrinth and Cloud Fortress}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|Northstrider left an echo of himself within [[labyrinth|the labyrinth]] and maintains a [[cloud fortress]].<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c3">''Dreadgod'', chapter 3</ref><ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c4">''Dreadgod'', chapter 4</ref> Utilizing [[spiritual perception]] and an [[oracle codex]] for predictions, this [[Monarch]] was expected to attend a meeting with [[Luminous Queen Sha Miara|Sha Miara]].<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c4" /><ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c22">''Dreadgod'', chapter 22</ref> While [[Lindon]] once witnessed an image of him battling the [[Wandering Titan]], Northstrider is also noted for having refused to deign to help.<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c6">''Dreadgod'', chapter 6</ref><ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c7">''Dreadgod'', chapter 7</ref> Having discovered the completed [[Grand Oath Array]] at least two hundred years ago, he possesses the resources necessary to reverse-engineer Books.<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c7" /><ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c10">''Dreadgod'', chapter 10</ref> During a battle, he crashed from high above while trailing a red dragon of blood and [[hunger madra]].<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c18">''Dreadgod'', chapter 18</ref> He can pull constructs from a personal [[void space]] containing high-value projects, and his hands appeared black-scaled and shining with blood and [[hunger]].<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c18" /><ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c19">''Dreadgod'', chapter 19</ref><ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c22" /> After focusing on [[Lindon]], he delivered a punch layered with an [[Enforcer technique]] that matched one of [[Lindon]]'s blows.<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c19" /><ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c21">''Dreadgod'', chapter 21</ref>}}

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Waybound combat}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|After emerging from [[Way|the Way]], Northstrider held out a palm during an attack and delivered a punch accompanied by an explosion of air.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c9">''Waybound'', chapter 9</ref> Utilizing the [[Authority|authority]] of the [[Strength Icon]], he forged a defensive layer of bloody [[madra]] around himself and established barriers surrounding [[Sacred Valley]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c9" /> He even used his [[madra]] to forge a serpentine dragon.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c9" /> While trading techniques with [[Lindon]], Northstrider was content to keep him locked in place.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c10">''Waybound'', chapter 10</ref> He fought off three other [[Heralds]] and an echo of himself, wielding both a [[Dreadgod weapon]] and a limb from the [[Slumbering Wraith]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c11">''Waybound'', chapter 11</ref> After sending [[Striker techniques]] toward [[Lindon]], he was blasted into the earth by a [[Black dragons|black dragon]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c11" /> Northstrider's [[Consume]] assisted in the creation of [[Yerin]]'s [[hunger techniques|hunger technique]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c12">''Waybound'', chapter 12</ref> His power thrashed inside [[Lindon]], though [[Lindon]] was able to push that power through a bond to [[Orthos]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c17">''Waybound'', chapter 17</ref> Ultimately, [[Lindon]] delivered a blow to the [[Weeping Dragon]]'s head that was worthy of Northstrider.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c19">''Waybound'', chapter 19</ref>}}

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Sunken Tower}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Northstrider maintains his seat of power within a fortress known as the [[Sunken Tower]], where his [[Authority|authority]] remains absolute.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c23">''Waybound'', chapter 23</ref> Residing in a simple gray room on the thirtieth floor, he was previously tutored by [[Lindon]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c23" /> Utilizing [[spiritual perception]] to envelop the world for hundreds of miles, he locked the entrance to [[Emriss Silentborn|Emriss]]'s prison.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c23" /><ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c24">''Waybound'', chapter 24</ref> Driven by a [[Monarch]]-level willpower, he intended to gather enough power to force the [[Abidan]] to remove the [[Dreadgods]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c24" /> During an attempt to destroy an echo of his past self, he utilized a [[Consume]] technique that caused white and gray to flood into him.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c24" /> Despite his experience manipulating [[Way|the Way]], he lacks an established clan or sect and harbors a fear of ascending.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c24" /> After [[Lindon]] forced him to advance, Northstrider sent instructions to [[Dross]] as he intended to make a clean break.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c24" /><ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c26">''Waybound'', chapter 26</ref>}}

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Threshold: Stories from Cradle}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Due to the stability of [[Sanctum]], Northstrider's techniques have seen a reduction in collateral damage.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c4">''Threshold: Stories from Cradle'', chapter 4</ref> He possesses an [[oracle codex]], a connection to multiple [[Icons]], and [[spiritual perception]].<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c4" /> Since ascending, his perception has evolved beyond that of a [[Monarch]], and he possesses a gift for working with time.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c4" /> Northstrider has integrated many [[dragons]] into himself and maintains a perfect, unassailable body.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c4" /> His curiosity resonates with [[hunger madra]] while he utilizes a [[Wind aura|wind aura]].<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c4" /> Although his body was once broken and twisted, his [[Authority|authority]] has the power to heal [[Lindon]].<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c12">''Threshold: Stories from Cradle'', chapter 12</ref><ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c14">''Threshold: Stories from Cradle'', chapter 14</ref>}}
<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">11</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|[[Northstrider]]'s techniques were reduced in collateral damage by the stability of [[Sanctum]].<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c4" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|[[Northstrider]] has an [[oracle codex]] and a connection to multiple [[Icons]].<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c4" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|[[Northstrider]] has evolved his perception from that of a [[Monarch]] since ascending.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c4" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|[[Northstrider]] has a gift for working with time.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c4" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|[[Northstrider]] has made many [[dragons]] part of himself.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c4" />}}</li>

== Notable quotes ==
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-05-ghostwater|Return the Eye of the Deep to the tree,” Northstrider instructed, golden eyes turning to the massive scripted device. “You may ask one question and receive one drop of ghostwater.<ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c16" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|“Northstrider,” Suriel said. “Path of the Hungry Deep.”<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c3" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|“You thinking Northstrider can split us up again after?”<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c26" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-09-bloodline|“Has the time come for the champion to name her wish?” Northstrider asked.<ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c14" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|“I need your word that you won’t attack me while my guard is down,” Northstrider said.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c24" />}}
